name: Control Weather

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: the weather within 5 miles of you

summary: Take control of the weather within 5 miles of you, shifting precipitation, temperature and wind a stage at a time.
text: You must be outdoors; each change moves one stage on its scale (precipitation from clear to blizzard, temperature from unbearable heat to arctic cold, wind from calm to storm, plus wind direction) and takes 1d4 x 10 minutes to arrive. The weather drifts back to normal when the spell ends.
